note: A Verilog case with a default toward VHDL. No open issue: hif2vhdl emits WHEN OTHERS and the full circle closes, and this design exists to keep it that way. The mirror of combinational/vhdl_case, and a different mapping rather than the same one twice: VHDL always has an others to carry across, whereas a Verilog case need not have a default at all, so going this way the backend must synthesise the exhaustiveness VHDL requires instead of preserving something already present. The stimulus ends on an x selector, which is what separates a real WHEN OTHERS from an explicit WHEN "11" - both serve 2'b11, only OTHERS also serves a selector that is not a defined value.
